TCP.point_definition: Midpoint of the two inner fingertip ends at the opening used for the user measurement; not the centre of the entire contact pad
TCP.TCP_frame_axes: Parallel to flange axes by definition, not a claim of measured jaw alignment

user_measurements.reference_opening: Current near-open configuration; no intervening commanded gripper movement

photo_observations: Blue printed part lies between metal robot mounting face and black gripper assembly.
Printed part has an outward extension supporting the wrist camera.
Assembly appears approximately centred; photographs do not establish zero lateral offset or tilt.
